source: Find a Tender and Contracts Finder award-stage OCDS notices, Open Government Licence v3, plus 9 legacy rows imported from the retired page 703 on 21/08/2026.
scopeRule: AWARDS only — a notice appears here once it has resolved to an award, never while it is open for bidding (open notices live in data/open-tenders.json). Scope is CPV division 33 (medical equipment, pharmaceuticals and personal care products) by headline classification, or a high-confidence device term in the title. Buyer names are never matched on.

coverage.note: Find a Tender is walked back to a probed floor of 2021-01-01. Contracts Finder is fetched in per-day publishedFrom/publishedTo date-time windows, each split further if it would hit the feed's 20-page cursor cap (walked this way 2021-01-01 to 2026-09-29, 318919 releases read, none unreachable); both feeds are therefore walked for notices published from 2021-01-01, and notices published before that are not fetched on either feed, so this is a known limit, not a claim of completeness. An absence here is a statement about this index, never about the buyer or the market.

republishedNote: 228 notices repeat an award already listed (same buyer, supplier, title, award date and value, republished by the buyer) and are not listed again; each award appears once, under its most recent notice.
valueNote: A value of null means the notice does not disclose one: either no value is published, or the published value is a placeholder of GBP 1 or less. Nothing is estimated in its place.
endDateNote: Only 5759 of 7537 awards carry a contract end date. Find a Tender award notices mostly do not publish one, so the forward contract calendar is limited by what the feeds state, not by what this page displays — a missing end date is unknown, never 'no end date'.
